law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act, 2006 (Act No. 19 of 2006)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (corporate-owned and anonymous or pseudonymous works: 50 years from first publication; photographs: 50 years from making)
orphan_works: No orphan regime in 2006 Act; 2025 Amendment Bill (passed 17 Mar 2026, assent unconfirmed) allows licensing orphan works if author untraceable
digital_protection: 2006 Act silent on TPMs; Copyright and Neighbouring Rights (Amendment) Act 2026 (Gazette 22 May 2026) defines and prohibits circumvention of TPMs and RMI removal
fair_use_exceptions: Fair use (s. 15: private study, teaching, news reporting)
pending_change: Copyright (Amendment) Bill 2025 (orphan works licensing) passed 17 Mar 2026; presidential assent not confirmed
